status: Cross-controller equipment foundation passed local engine, client, lint and native checks; no control-changing card is admitted.
rules: Core 718.2: printed gear abilities are inactive while attached. An explicit permission can reattach gear; ordinary printed Equip is unavailable until detached.
Core 718.3 and 718.5: equipment text belongs to its bearer, while control of the physical gear remains independent.
Core 719.3 and 107.1.c.1: attached gear shares its bearer's actual location, including an opposing base.
Core 323.6: unattached permanents in an opposing base are recalled to their controller's base during cleanup.
Core 191.5.b: a pending ability retains its controller after the source changes control.
implementation: Find attachments across both players; preserve the gear controller and return gear to its own owner when destroyed. Guardian Angel protects its bearer across controllers; opposing Zhonya's Hourglass does not.
Evaluate granted passives and triggers using the bearer's controller. Preserve the gear as provenance. Rust passive contributions expose the rules controller separately from the source.
Track actual base identity after detachment until cleanup. Full board-target locations distinguish the two bases; dangling attachments have no valid location.

Resolve generic stored trigger sources by persistent physical identity. Keep the pending ability controller and per-object once-per-turn history when control changes. This is not a complete stored-target audit.
Show foreign-controlled gear on unit badges and attachment lists, open the correct physical gear inspector, and display the bearer's XP for granted Level effects.

validation.native_initial_state: Authored foreign-controller attachment state; subsequent badge, list, inspector and close controls use actual native clicks.
validation.visual_findings: Viewed small-window attachment list and Soul Sword inspector plus normal-window opponent unit hover. Both equipment pieces are visible, the inspector identifies the gear controller, and the unit hover reports the bearer's 3 XP with the active Level bonus. Long content uses the existing scrollable inspector.

findings_corrected: Review found that the live passive calculation used bearer XP but the inspector still described gear-controller XP. A both-seat regression now checks active/inactive Level text on both the unit and gear inspectors.
The source contract now distinguishes explicit reattachment permissions from the inactive printed Equip ability.
remaining_before_card_admission: Actual control-transfer operation with contest/combat cleanup ordering and ownership preservation.
All stored target/reference paths, with live friendly/enemy revalidation and absolute-base instructed replay.
Possession and Conscription targeting, optional XP payment, rollback, AI and public observations.
Ownership-aware conservation checks and end-to-end card play, API and installed acceptance.
limits: Foreign-control initial states are authored; these tests do not prove a playable control-changing action.
The JSON observation contract has not yet been extended to expose separate ownership and granted-ability controller.
No new preset or card is enabled. All-current-card coverage, full Standard parity, expert strength and human learning remain unproven.
The concurrently accepted entry release is a separate revision without these changes.
